entertainment.bd (Tayyib Vista)

Tayyib Vista is a global halal entertainment directory and curation platform: verified, rated YouTube channels, documentaries, children's animation, podcasts and apps checked against an 8-point Shariah and modesty standard, with Dhaka prayer times and a Qibla compass.
